Players Committee card image of [[Cloud City: Security Tower (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Dark: If Any Methods Necessary just played, may take Despair into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Aiiii! Aaa! Agggggggggg! is canceled. Light: If you control, may use 3 Force to release a captive here. Captive Pursuit is canceled.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/cloudcitysecuritytower.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
